title: Louis Dumaine, how long with Kid Howard, and George Lewis
summary: He identifies Louis Dumaine, says he played with Howard off and on, and talks about George Lewis.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you ever know Louis Dumaine?

That's the thing I was trying to call. That's the guy made an offer to me to teach me music. He was crazy about my bass drum playing too. That's the name I was trying to call, Louis Dumaine. Yeah. Fine old man. Fine, fine guy. He was playing in the same band with us when Howard had his brass band.
I see. How long were you with Howard?

Well, obviously I played with Howard up until he'd taken sick. Until he'd give up. I fell on with him. When he went. Off and on. Yeah, off and on. Then when he went with George Lewis, well he even tried to get me when Jill Watkin had taken sick away from here first time. He tried to get me to come up there to play with the band and I think it was in Cincinnati. He always kept his mind on me. But something happened or I think they had to have a drummer right away and they hired somebody else. That was the first chance I ever had to try to get with George Lewis band. How would they like to play with his band? He liked to get joined his band but Joe Watkin was his drummer and such. Well, they were real tight those two. Yeah. But George Lewis was playing around here with us too with Kit Howard. He was with Kit Howard in the same band. He was in the same band. So you played with George a lot? Yeah. Oh yeah. He's a nice guy. Oh wonderful.
Wonderful. Wonderful. Well I like his style and everything. I do too. And he's world famous now. Yes. But you played on Bourbon Street too. Yeah well like I said I played Bourbon Street.
